text:
ryan: quick update 1: we ran a short canary for decode-prefetch + lightweight-quant on a few ded nodes this morning. results attached below. :rocket:

marta: TL;DR?

ryan: median down ~20%, p95 down ~7%, p99 about the same, token-cost down ~24%. throughput up ~14% on chat-heavy load.

simon: bench output pls + config flags.

ryan: bench (pool: gd-dedicated-medium, model: rw-7b-econ-quant):

```
DECODE-PREFETCH CANARY - 2026-03-23 07:40 UTC
Model: rw-7b-econ-quant
Profile: 50% chat, 50% gen
Baseline: p50=68ms, p95=200ms, p99=320ms, tokens/s=920, cost=$0.0118/1k
Canary: p50=54ms, p95=186ms, p99=322ms, tokens/s=1050, cost=$0.00898/1k
Delta: p50 -20.6%, p95 -7.0%, p99 +0.6%, throughput +14.1%, cost -23.9%
Flags: decode_prefetch.enabled=true, decode_prefetch.window=8, quant.mode=lightweight
Notes: small jitter during sustained 90s bursts; no functional regressions observed.
```

ci-bot: canary checks: latency/pass, error-rate=0.09%, mem pressure low. all green.

marta: edge cases? very short completions or extremely long context?

ryan: short completions (<8 tokens) show negligible change. long contexts (>3k) show slight increase in GPU mem reads; plan to gate prefetch for seq_len>3200.

simon: rollout plan?

ryan: increase canary to 40% tonight, run 6h stability pass, if stable 80% tomorrow, full GA after smoke tests. rollback via feature toggle or pool flag. quick curl to disable: 

```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/internal/flags \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"pool":"gd-dedicated-medium","flags":{"decode_prefetch.enabled":false}}'
```

ops-bot: created ticket INF-4955 "Add per-route prefetch toggle and cost projection" assigned to simon. https://rwinf.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4955

marta: please add an alert for p95 regressions + memory read anomalies. 10min window.

ryan: adding alert and dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/canaries/decode-prefetch-2935001234

simon: nice work team. cost numbers look great.

ryan: will post a short blurb to #releases after 80% stability. :thumbsup:
